AnchorReading.description:
An official reading from a government page: a national threat level, or another
government's travel advice for a country.

scale.description: Allowed raw values, lowest to highest
scale.title: Scale

raw.description: Value read from the page, one of scale
raw.title: Raw

since.description: Date the level was declared, if stated
since.title: Since

as_of.description: Last time the value was read successfully
as_of.title: As Of

text_hash.description: sha1 of the paragraph stating the level, to detect any change in wording
text_hash.title: Text Hash

detail.description: Other levels in force at the same time, e.g. a higher level for railways only
detail.title: Detail

manual.description: Typed in by hand from the official page, because the page cannot be read automatically
manual.title: Manual

kind.description: national: a country's own threat level; travel: another government's travel advice for this country
kind.title: Kind

issuer.description: ISO alpha-2 of the government that issues the travel advice (travel only)
issuer.title: Issuer

AnchorReading.title: AnchorReading

severity.description: 0 not an incident, 1 arrest or disrupted plot, 2 attempted attack, 3 attack without deaths, 4 attack with 1 to 4 deaths, 5 attack with 5 or more deaths
severity.title: Severity

Gtd.description: Yearly Global Terrorism Database counts (static/gtd_aggregates.json, aggregates only).
Gtd.title: Gtd

published_estimated.description: True when the source gave no date; published_at is then when the item was first seen
published_estimated.title: Published Estimated

provisional.description: True while the event history is shorter than two weeks: computed and recorded, but not shown as a level
provisional.title: Provisional

official.description: SIS level for SK; none for the EU, which has no EU-wide level

sample.description: True for made-up sample data used to develop the frontend; the site labels it on every page
sample.title: Sample

from_buffer.description: Items read from the hourly RSS collector's buffer
from_buffer.title: From Buffer

SisAnnual.description: Points from the latest SIS annual report, summarised by hand (manual_anchors.yaml).
SisAnnual.title: SisAnnual

zero_runs.description: Successful runs in a row with no items
zero_runs.title: Zero Runs

Tesat.description: Europol TE-SAT yearly figures, typed in from the PDF (manual_anchors.yaml).
Tesat.title: Tesat

countries.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2, EU expanded to its member states; the map places a report in this theatre when it names one of them
countries.title: Countries

sparkline.description: Activity value per day, oldest first, up to 30 days
sparkline.title: Sparkline

Timeseries.description: timeseries.json: one row per region per run, never pruned.
Timeseries.title: Timeseries

gates.description: Gates that changed the level in this run (a cap lowered it, or the floor raised it)
gates.title: Gates
